title: Vectors and the Dot Product
summary: Vectors, norms, cosine similarity and matrix-vector products - the language of embeddings and neurons.
objectives: Predict the output shape of a matrix-vector product
socratic_prompts: Why does cosine similarity ignore vector length?
What does a dot product of zero tell you geometrically?

examples.title: Cosine similarity
examples.code:
import numpy as np
a, b = np.array([1., 2.]), np.array([2., 4.])
print(a @ b / (np.linalg.norm(a) * np.linalg.norm(b)))  # 1.0
